summary: Round r1 (restricted network). Leads recorded for higher education (UGC EMIS), TVET (CTEVT, skill testing), tertiary GER and R&D intensity (WDI/UIS), employer-reported skill gaps (World Bank Enterprise Surveys, NLFS) and demand-side skills evidence (World Bank SADU Oct 2025, existing lead). Most education-specific URLs are from general knowledge and unverified; the ADB education sector assessment is search-verified. No values retrieved; all empirical items pending. Key methodological points: GERD vs budget appropriation, UGC faculty vs ISCED-F classification, and seats vs certified completions for TVET.

findings.claim: Q1: Tertiary gross enrolment ratio by sex.
Q1: Higher-education enrolment by faculty/field, level and sex (national, by province).
findings.period: academic year 2080/81 BS or latest UGC EMIS report
findings.note: Required: UGC EMIS Report on Higher Education (09B-L01).

findings.claim: Q1: Tertiary graduates by field (STEM share, ISCED-F broad fields) and sex.
findings.note: Required: UGC graduate tables (09B-L01), UIS graduates by field (09B-L06). Keep UGC (national faculty classification) and UIS (ISCED-F) separate; mapping required.

findings.claim: Q1: TVET capacity - approved annual seats and enrolment in CTEVT long-term programmes (TSLC, diploma) and short-term trainees; skill-test (NSTB) candidates and pass counts.
findings.period: latest CTEVT annual report (Nepal FY / academic year)

findings.claim: Q1: Share of upper-secondary students in technical/vocational streams (incl. technical stream in community schools).
findings.note: Required: UIS TVET participation (09B-L06), CEHRD Flash (see 09A-L14).

findings.claim: Q2: Gross domestic expenditure on R&D (GERD) as share of GDP; researchers per million.
findings.period: latest reported year; basis (FY vs calendar) to confirm
findings.note: Required: GB.XPD.RSDV.GD.ZS (09B-L05), UIS R&D (09B-L06), UNESCO Science Report (09B-L12). If no national R&D survey exists, record that fact rather than proxy.

findings.claim: Q2: Government budget allocation to science/technology and research institutions (NAST, UGC research grants).
findings.note: Required: budget Red Book / Economic Survey (09B-L13). Budget appropriation is not GERD; label as proxy.

findings.claim: Q3: Employer-reported skill gaps - share of firms citing inadequately educated workforce as a major constraint; share offering formal training.
findings.period: latest Enterprise Survey round for Nepal

findings.claim: Q3: Skills demanded in online job postings and AI-exposure of white-collar occupations in Nepal.
Q3: Graduate labour-market outcomes - unemployment/underutilisation by education level; occupation-education mismatch.
GERD and budget allocations are different concepts; budget appropriations for science will not be used as a GERD estimate.
findings.note: Definition per Frascati Manual (OECD); recorded to prevent substitution.

findings.claim: TVET capacity is measured as annual training seats/completions plus skill-test certifications; not all trainees are certified and not all certified workers trained formally.
findings.note: Method choice for the talent-flow model.

data_gaps: UGC EMIS higher-education report (latest academic year): URL for the specific report not located.
CTEVT seat and enrolment statistics by trade: specific report URL not located.
R&D expenditure: it is unconfirmed whether Nepal has ever conducted a Frascati-compliant R&D survey; GERD may be unavailable.
Enterprise Survey workforce module: latest Nepal round year and URL unconfirmed.
NLFS: whether a round after NLFS III (2017/18) has been published is unconfirmed.

assumptions.text: GERD (Frascati) is not proxied by science budget appropriations.
TVET capacity = seats and certified completions, both reported, never merged.

challenges.text: 24A AI-exposure analysis of IT/BPO should be paired with 09B supply-side counts of ICT/engineering graduates; exposure without graduate supply numbers cannot assess the export-services pathway.
Any productivity-growth assumption for services exports should state the skilled-labour supply it requires (graduates by field per year), to be checked against 09B tertiary_profile once retrieved.

uncertainty: High. No values retrieved. Most leads for UGC, CTEVT, UIS, WDI and Enterprise Surveys are from general knowledge and unverified. R&D data may not exist for Nepal. Field classifications differ between national and international sources.

tertiary_profile.method: Keep UGC faculty classification and ISCED-F separate; map with a documented concordance; academic years in BS.

tvet_capacity.method: Extract from CTEVT annual reports; compare with outbound labour-migration demand by occupation from 09C/23A to estimate the supply gap.

rnd_intensity.method: Use UIS/WDI GERD if reported; state explicitly if Nepal has no R&D survey; do not impute.
